title: Switch between Object and Edit mode

steps.instruction: Select your object, then open the mode menu that says Object Mode.
steps.spoken: Click your object first. Then open the menu that says Object Mode.
steps.why: Blender has different modes for different jobs, like tools in a toolbox.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The mode menu is the first dropdown on the left of the 3D view header.

steps.spoken: Choose Edit Mode. Now you can change the shape itself, point by point.
steps.why: Object mode moves the whole object. Edit mode changes its shape.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Edit Mode is the second item in the list. You can also press Tab.

steps.spoken: Open the mode menu again. It now says Edit Mode.
steps.why: You should always know which mode you are in before you change something.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The same dropdown, still on the left of the 3D view header.

steps.instruction: Choose Object Mode to go back.
steps.spoken: Choose Object Mode to go back to moving the whole object.
steps.why: Pressing Tab does the same thing, and it is much faster.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Object Mode is the first item in the list.
